name: com.moyun365.commonpush.receiver.HuaweiPushRevicer
description: CommonPush (Moyun365) handles Huawei push registration, messages, connection status and notification taps. It saves the Huawei registration token and sends event details to the library's registered app callbacks.
disableEffect: Huawei push registration, messages and notification-tap events will no longer reach CommonPush.
